items.markdown:
A Thailand retirement visa is `available to foreign nationals aged 50 and older` . The primary options are the **Non-Immigrant O-A Visa** and the **Non-Immigrant O Visa extension** , requiring either **800,000 THB** in a Thai bank account or a monthly income of **65,000 THB** . You can submit applications online via the [Official Thai e-Visa Website](https://www.thaievisa.go.th/) or through local immigration offices.[](https://www.banyangroupresidences.com/news/thailand-retirement-visa-guide) [[1]](https://www.banyangroupresidences.com/news/thailand-retirement-visa-guide)[[2]](https://thailandelitevisa.com/thailand-retirement-visa-complete-guide/)[[3]](https://www.gov.uk/guidance/living-in-thailand)[[4]](https://wise.com/gb/blog/thai-retirement-visa)

Key Visa Types & Stay Lengths

- **Non-Immigrant O Visa (In-Country):** Initial 90-day entry extendable to a 1-year annual residency within Thailand.
- **Non-Immigrant O-A Visa (Applied Abroad):** 1-year multiple-entry visa requiring medical checks and police clearance.
- **Non-Immigrant O-X Visa:** 5-year renewable long-stay visa (up to 10 years total) for select nationalities with higher financial thresholds.
- **Long-Term Resident (LTR) Visa:** 10-year visa aimed at wealthy pensioners with high annual passive income.[](https://www.banyangroupresidences.com/news/thailand-retirement-visa-guide) [[1]](https://www.youtube.com/shorts/Fi6X4vM26eY)[[2]](https://thailand-elite.com/blog/retirement-visa-thailand-comparison-2026)

Core Financial & Legal Requirements

- **Age Limit:** Must be at least 50 years old on the date of application.
- **Savings Option:** Maintain at least 800,000 THB in a Thai bank account (seasoned for 2 to 3 months prior to applying).
- **Income Option:** Proof of a stable monthly pension or income of at least 65,000 THB.
- **Combined Option:** Total annual income and bank deposits equaling 800,000 THB.
- **Health Insurance:** Mandatory coverage for inpatient and outpatient care specifically for O-A and O-X visa classes.
- **Restrictions:** Employment of any kind is strictly forbidden on standard retirement visas.[](https://www.thaiembassy.com/thailand-visa/retirement-visa) [[1]](https://www.thaiembassy.com/thailand-visa/retirement-visa)[[2]](https://www.legalink.net/xms/files/Newsletters/ASIA_WissenCo_Article_retirement_visas.pdf)

Ongoing Responsibilities

- **90-Day Reporting:** Must notify the Thai Immigration Bureau of your current residential address every 90 days.
- **Annual Renewal:** Visas must be renewed every 12 months by re-proving financial or insurance compliance.[](https://www.thaiembassy.com/thailand-visa/retirement-visa) [[1]](https://www.youtube.com/shorts/V-SovMAFLiE)
